items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: The period of Bessie Smith and Ma Rainey

ctx.x: I can remember some. I remember Dad James. I don't know if you can think about him. I don't remember. He was a good singer. And Luke Cannon.

We collect records. Of course, I've always collected records for 20 or 30 years now. And I have a lot of the old time records, too. The period of Bessie Smith and Ma Rainey and everyone of that kind. Oh, yes. So unless a person recorded, I wouldn't know a lot of those names.
Well, now, I wouldn't really know if they recorded those things or not. But they were in, they were standards. They stayed at the show. Other acts came, but they stayed.
